_meanings:
.²1 A measure; see {#mAtram#} above.
.²2 A standard of measure, standard, rule.
.²3 The correct measure; {#tasya mAtrA na vidyate#} <ls>Mb. 13. 93. 45</ls>.
.²4 A unit of measure, a foot.
.²5 A moment.
.²6 A particle, an atom; {#pfTivI ca pfTivImAtrA#} <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Praśna. Up. 4. 8</ls>.
.²7 A part, portion; {#laBemahi DanamAtrAn#} <ls>Ch. Up. 1. 10. 6</ls>; {#surendramAtrASritagarBagOravAt#} <ls>R. 3. 11</ls>.
.²8 A small portion, a little, trifle, a little quantity, a small measure
 only; see {#mAtra#} (3).
.²9 Account, consideration; {#rAjeti kriyatI mAtrA#} <ls>Pt. 1. 40</ls> ‘of what
 account or consideration is a king’, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} I hold him of no account;
 {#kAyasTa iti laDvI mAtrA#} <ls>Mu. 1</ls>.
.²10 Money, wealth, property; {#SUnyamaWikAyAM mAtrAH samavatArya#} <ls>Dk. 2. 8</ls>;
 {#naktaMdinaM kakzAntarAttAM mAtrAM na muYcati#} <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; {#kaTamasyArTamAtrA#}
 {#hartavyA#} {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%}
.²11 (In prosody) A prosodial or syllabic instant, the time required to
 pronounce a short vowel; {#gacCet zoqaSamAtrABiH#} <ls>Śukra. 4. 963</ls>; {#ekamAtro#}
 {#Baved hnasvaH#}.
.²12 An element.
.²13 The material world, matter.
.²14 The upper part of the Nāgarī characters.
.²15 An ear-ring.
.²16 An ornament; a jewel.
.²17 A measure of time (in music.).
.²18 Function of the organs ({#indriyavftti#}).
.²19 Change ({#vikAra#}); {#sanniveSyAtmamAtrAsu sarvaBUtAni nirmame#} <ls>Ms. 1. 16</ls>.
.²20 = {#budDiH#}; {#na mAtrAmanuruDyante#} <ls>Mb. 12. 270. 12</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> {#mIyate#}
 {#vizayA anayeti mAtrA budDiH#}).

a measure equal to the middle digit of the middle finger
 in the right hand of the architect or priest, employed in measuring the
 sacrificial objects like the kuśa grass or seat, the spout of a ladle,
 and the ladle <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Suprabhedāgama 30. 4/5</ls>, <ls n="Suprabhedāgama 30.">7/8</ls>.
(food) heavy on account of its ingredients.

a metre regulated by the number of prosodial
 instants it contains, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} the Āryā.

attachment to or regard for household possessions or property;
 {#prARayAtrikamAtraH syAnmAtrAsaNgAdvinirgataH#} <ls>Ms. 6. 57</ls>.
<ab>N.</ab> of a class of metres; see <ls>App.</ls>

material contact, contact with material elements; {#mAtrAsparSAstu#}
 {#kOnteya SItozRasuKaduHKadAH#} <ls>Bg. 2. 14</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 6. 35</ls>.
